title: Compute interaction energies
action: Implement the four-atom Anderson model with parameters: adatom level E_a0 = -U/2, chain hopping T = 0.5, adatom–end-site hopping V. Use a half-filled band (two spin-up, two spin-down). Build the Hamiltonian in the 36-state S_z=0 basis and diagonalize to obtain the ground-state energy. Compute the interaction energy ΔW = E_ground − E_0 where E_0 = -U/2 − 2√2 T (the energy of the dissociated system). Compute the weak-binding interaction energy ΔW_w from the second-order perturbation formula given in the method description. Compute the rebonded surface complex (RSC) energy by solving the surface dimer exactly, adding the separation energy, and then computing the second-order rebonding correction. Compute the restricted Hartree-Fock (RHF) energy from the analytic RHF formula. Compute the unrestricted Hartree-Fock (URHF) energy by solving the self-consistent equations via minimization as described in the method. For U ∈ {1.0, 2.5, 4.0} and V ∈ {0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2.0, 2.25, 2.5}, produce one row of data for each combination.
description: CSV with columns U,V,exact_deltaW,weak_deltaW,RSC_deltaW,RHF_deltaW,URHF_deltaW for all (U,V) pairs.
output_schema: CSV header: U,V,exact_deltaW,weak_deltaW,RSC_deltaW,RHF_deltaW,URHF_deltaW. Each row is one (U,V) combination. Values are floating-point numbers (units such that 2T=1, T=0.5).

title: Verify weak-binding asymptotic limits
action: Using the weak-binding interaction energy formula from the method description, compute the quantity |ΔW_w| * U / V² for U=4.0, V=1e-4, T=0.5 and for U=0.1, V=1e-4, T=0.5. Write the results to a CSV.
description: CSV containing the computed ratios for the two limiting cases.
output_schema: CSV header: U,V,ratio. Two rows: one for U=4.0, V=1e-4 and one for U=0.1, V=1e-4. ratio is a floating-point number.
